FULL TEXT:
University Institute of Laws
Panjab University Regional Centre, Ludhiana
Dated:26th July, 2024
Advertisement for the Post of Guest Faculty of Law
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the post of One Guest Faculty to teach the
Subject of Law at University Institute of Laws, P.U. Regional Centre, Ludhiana for the Odd
Semester (Academic Session 2024-25).
Educational Qualifications:
a) Master’s Degree in Law with good academic record as defined by the University with at
least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwD) or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever
the grading system is followed.
b) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
like SLET/SET.
c) Candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the
University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D.
Degree) Regulations, 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum
eligibility condition of NET/SLET/SET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant
Professor or equivalent positions in Universities/Colleges/Institutions.
Important Instructions:
1. The applicants are required to fill the application form (page 1 to 9) for the Assistant
Professors available on the website of the Panjab University, Chandigarh available at
http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php. Link https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf
2. Application form, complete in all respects, along with self-attested copies of all the
supporting documents must reach the office of The Director, Panjab University Regional
Centre, Ludhiana-141001 by 5th August, 2024 upto 4.00 p.m. The candidates may submit
the hard copies of the forms and documents or soft copies duly self attested by electronic
mode (Email) at dirpurcldh@pu.ac.in
3. The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token of honorarium of Rs. 1500/-per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs.50,000/-per month.
4. Working hours for the appointee will be 9.00 am to 5.00pm (Monday to Friday).
5. The candidate shall have to undertake that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or
any financial assistance from any agency and will do the same till they are teaching at UIL,
P.U. Regional Centre, Ludhiana.
6. Candidates shortlisted will be intimated about the date and timings for the interview by
email only. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
7. The candidates who had submitted the form and documents via Email need to bring the
hard copies of the form and the self attested documents at the time of Interview.
Sd/-
Director
P.U. Regional Centre, Ludhiana
